meaning.zh: 矩阵记录公共能力及其边界，不按成功加载数量推算兼容率。完整支持仅用于已穷尽验证的明确范围；当前没有整类标为完整支持。
meaning.en: This matrix tracks shared capabilities and boundaries, not compatibility percentages inferred from successful loads. Full support requires exhaustive evidence for a defined scope; no whole category is currently marked full.

categories.verifiedZh: 官方目录搜索、稳定原包安装、SHA-256、默认禁用、错误重试。
categories.verifiedEn: Official catalog search, stable original packages, SHA-256, disabled-on-install and retry.
categories.remainingZh: 更新、卸载和任意 ZIP 导入待实现。
categories.remainingEn: Updates, uninstall and arbitrary ZIP imports remain unimplemented.

categories.verifiedZh: 正文快照、选区、单事务撤销、保存与过期提交拒绝；六个原包指定操作。
categories.verifiedEn: Body snapshots, selections, single-transaction undo, save and stale-commit rejection; selected operations from six packages.
categories.remainingZh: 不等于完整 Editor API；旧 v3、源码模式及无法证明的富文本位置不支持。
categories.remainingEn: Not the complete Editor API; v3, source mode and unprovable rich-text positions are unsupported.

categories.verifiedZh: 定时器、布局就绪、编辑/文件事件串行执行；禁用清理并取消等待。
categories.verifiedEn: Timers, layout-ready and edit/file events serialize; disabling cleans up and cancels waiting calls.
categories.remainingZh: 尚未覆盖所有 Obsidian 事件、多窗口活动上下文和后台插件类型。
categories.remainingEn: Not all Obsidian events, multi-window contexts or background plugin classes are covered.

categories.verifiedZh: Markdown 索引、read/create/modify/process、CAS、正文坐标元数据和原生属性写入。
categories.verifiedEn: Markdown index, read/create/modify/process, CAS, body-position metadata and native property writes.
categories.remainingZh: 最多 5000 篇；无真实时间戳、完整反链、附件/二进制写；属性写仅限打开的笔记。
categories.remainingEn: 5000-note limit; no real timestamps, complete backlinks or attachment/binary writes; property writes require an open note.

categories.verifiedZh: 原包设置控件、基础 Modal/SuggestModal、按智库保存。
categories.verifiedEn: Original settings controls, basic Modal/SuggestModal and per-vault persistence.
categories.remainingZh: 控件与弹窗 API 尚未全覆盖；原包 UI 在 Bridge 管理窗口中。
categories.remainingEn: Incomplete control/modal API; original UI lives in the Bridge manager.

categories.verifiedZh: 原包多组默认键位、原生改键/解绑、跨设置窗口同步、禁用清理；Note Refactor 默认键与 Sort 自定义键。
categories.verifiedEn: Multiple original defaults, native rebinding/unbinding, settings-window sync and cleanup; Note Refactor default and custom Sort binding.
categories.remainingZh: 当前只在原生正文响应；尚无 Scope 栈、CM 键位或完整命令可用性展示；原生已处理键优先。
categories.remainingEn: Currently scoped to native note bodies; no Scope stack, CM keymaps or full command-availability presentation; handled native keys take priority.

categories.verifiedZh: 原版 Advanced Tables ItemView 工具栏挂入原生右侧栏；按钮事务、原生撤销、显式关闭重开、折叠恢复和禁用清理。
categories.verifiedEn: Original Advanced Tables ItemView in the native right sidebar; button transactions, native undo, explicit close/reopen, collapse/restore and disable cleanup.
categories.remainingZh: 每种视图仅一个实例；原生关闭按钮暂按挂载暂停处理，onClose 在显式 detach 或禁用时运行。跨重启状态、活动视图路由、任意 DOM 监听及复杂嵌入视图仍待补。
categories.remainingEn: One instance per type. Native close currently suspends mounting; onClose runs on explicit detach or disable. Cross-restart state, active-view routing, arbitrary DOM listeners and complex embedded views remain incomplete.

categories.verifiedZh: 代码块处理器和 MarkdownRenderChild 接入原生 v4；原版 Charts 3.9.0 绘制图表，原生源码编辑与撤销、源码切换、禁用回退和重新启用均保留 Markdown。
categories.verifiedEn: Code-block processors and MarkdownRenderChild in native v4; original Charts 3.9.0 paints charts, with native source edits/undo, source toggle, disable fallback and re-enable preserving Markdown.
categories.remainingZh: 普通 Markdown 后处理器、MarkdownRenderer、准确段落偏移、关联表格数据及完整主题事件仍待补；未宣称所有图表配置均兼容。
categories.remainingEn: General Markdown postprocessors, MarkdownRenderer, exact section offsets, linked table data and full theme events remain incomplete; not all chart configurations are claimed compatible.

categories.verifiedZh: 仅提供命令缓冲区的部分 CodeMirror 兼容对象。
categories.verifiedEn: Only partial CodeMirror objects for command buffers.
categories.remainingZh: 不执行任意 CM 扩展；Advanced Tables Tab、Linter 保存拦截与输入建议待接入。
categories.remainingEn: No arbitrary CM extensions; Advanced Tables Tab, Linter save interception and editor suggestions remain unimplemented.

categories.verifiedZh: Desktop、本地可信插件、浏览器 fetch、Moment 与 YAML。
categories.verifiedEn: Desktop, trusted local plugins, browser fetch, Moment and YAML.
categories.remainingZh: 无 Node/Electron 模块或移动端；requestUrl 受 CORS 限制；iframe 不是安全沙箱。
categories.remainingEn: No Node/Electron modules or mobile support; requestUrl is CORS-bound; iframe is not a security sandbox.
